x.tweet: Most startups hire twice a year. You don't need a thousand-dollar ATS. You need a kanban board, a calendar, and rejection emails that actually send.

vertical_caption: Tired of ghosting candidates because your hiring spreadsheet is a mess? Kanban, calendar sync, auto-reject emails. One-page tool for teams who hire occasionally 📋

video.title: Stop Ghosting Your Candidates
video.script: You drag resumes into a spreadsheet. Weeks pass. You forget to reject half of them. Inbox Hire flips the script. Drop resumes in, drag them between stages like a kanban board. Click once to schedule an interview. Rejections actually send automatically. No vendor lock-in, no monthly fee, just the four things hiring actually needs. Tap the link to try it.
